content.Clinical Practice Guidelines: Focus on coronary revascularization, tobacco cessation, management of chronic stable angina, prevention and management of cardiovascular disorders, pharmacologic approaches to glycemic treatment in diabetes, and sex differences in clinical outcomes and treatment.
content.Methodology: Recommendations derived from class of recommendation and level of evidence from various guidelines and studies.
content.Improving Equity in Care: Disparities in care in coronary intervention based on sex, race, and socioeconomic status are discussed. ACS protocols examined for mitigating disparities.
